notes.title: Challenge Action - Make our servers crash!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello my friends!
[b]We would like to start a new funny contest, you'll have to make our servers CRASH![/b]

In order to do that there will have to be A LOT of gamers playing [b]"Heaven Island VR MMO"[/b] ːbuddhaː and interacting with the environment. 

Invite your friends to play the game with you if you want to win!

Right now there are 200+ players connected to the game, if we reach 1000 gamers the server will probably crash and all of you connected to the game will win the prize!

The prize is a new key for our next game in development "The Rex" :)
[b]Contest ends the 7th of March.[/b]

let the challenge begin! ːespritː

	[/h1]

notes.title: New Name change! - Heaven Island VR MMO!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello my friends!
I would like to inform you that we had to change the name of the game due to some legal problems with a company with the same registered name.

We hope you'll like the new name we chose "Heaven Island - VR MMO"

we're still taking in consideration other names, let us know if you have any suggestions!

New updates will come in the next week.

with love, ːespritː
Chubby Pixel
[/h1]
